## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::OwnershipProposalExpired` — the proposal's acceptance window has elapsed.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::expired_proposal_cannot_be_accepted`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::expired_proposal_cannot_be_accepted). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// OwnershipProposalExpired — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
let target = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .propose_ownership_transfer(&f.sender, &id, &target);
f.advance_time(OWNERSHIP_PROPOSAL_TTL_SECONDS);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_accept_ownership_transfer(&target, &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked expired_proposal_cannot_be_accepted
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Propose a fresh ownership transfer; the acceptance window is `OWNERSHIP_PROPOSAL_TTL_SECONDS` and an expired proposal cannot be accepted.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer)
